concerns.text: FR‑007 in the specification requires flagging dequantization overhead only when it exceeds **10 %** of total energy, but the plan states a **5 %** threshold ("Dequantization overhead flag (>5 % & significant)"). This contradicts the functional requirement.

The InferenceRun schema (contracts/inference_run.schema.yaml) includes required fields `measurement_method` and `timestamp_iso`, yet the plan’s description of validation does not mention these fields, leaving ambiguity about how they will be populated.
